queries.schema: SELECT name,type,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name IN ('d1_migrations','restaurant_tables','staff_order_requests','staff_sessions','idx_orders_active_staff_table','orders_staff_revision_guard')
queries.config_columns: SELECT name,type,dflt_value FROM pragma_table_info('tenant_config') WHERE name IN ('staff_ordering_enabled','staff_ordering_capabilities')
queries.order_columns: SELECT name,type,dflt_value FROM pragma_table_info('orders') WHERE name IN ('table_id','source','revision')
queries.ledger: SELECT name,applied_at FROM d1_migrations ORDER BY name
queries.flags: SELECT tenant_id,staff_ordering_enabled,is_active FROM tenant_config ORDER BY tenant_id
queries.demo: SELECT t.id AS tenant_id,tc.is_active AS config_active,tc.staff_ordering_enabled,tc.allow_dine_in FROM tenants t LEFT JOIN tenant_config tc ON tc.tenant_id=t.id WHERE t.id='blab_demo'
queries.orders: SELECT tenant_id,status,COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders WHERE source='staff' GROUP BY tenant_id,status ORDER BY tenant_id,status
queries.tables: SELECT tenant_id,COUNT(*) AS total,SUM(CASE WHEN is_active=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active FROM restaurant_tables GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tenant_id
queries.sessions: SELECT tenant_id,COUNT(*) AS total,SUM(CASE WHEN revoked_at IS NULL AND datetime(expires_at)>datetime('now') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unexpired FROM staff_sessions GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tenant_id
queries.requests: SELECT tenant_id,COUNT(*) AS count FROM staff_order_requests GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tenant_id
queries.duplicates: SELECT tenant_id,table_id,COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders WHERE source='staff' AND table_id IS NOT NULL AND status NOT IN ('PAID','REJECTED','PICKED_UP') GROUP BY tenant_id,table_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1

schema.name: d1_migrations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE d1_migrations(
		id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
		name       TEXT UNIQUE,
		applied_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
)

schema.name: restaurant_tables
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE restaurant_tables (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    label TEXT NOT NULL,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenant_config(tenant_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

schema.name: idx_orders_active_staff_table
schema.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_orders_active_staff_table
ON orders(tenant_id, table_id)
WHERE source = 'staff' AND status NOT IN ('PAID', 'REJECTED', 'PICKED_UP')

)

schema.name: orders_staff_revision_guard
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER orders_staff_revision_guard
BEFORE UPDATE OF revision ON orders
WHEN NEW.revision < 0
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'REVISION_CONFLICT: CHECK constraint failed: revision >= 0');
END

fix(pos): resolve auto-print infinite loop, add polling timeout, and build v1.0.3 APKs (#67)

- Add AbortController 8s timeout to fetchOrders polling to prevent hung network requests
- Clean up canvas backing store dimensions after toDataURL in PrinterService
- Restore sticker footer rendering in drawStickerLayout
- Bump orders.html cache-busters to v20261016_autoprint_loop_fix_v2
- Build and package Android POS APK v1.0.3 (code 27) for universal prod and pilot
